title: Cat Video Fest HK 2026 (Cat & Dog)
synopsis:
Cats are occupying Broadway Cinematheque! We have searched the city and handpicked the ultimate local cat video selection. Whether they are energetic kittens, unapologetically grumpy cats, or adventurous felines storming your home - every cat is a diva in the spotlight.

 

Part of the proceeds will be donated to local animal charity LAP to support their animal rescue mission.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
電影中心貓出沒注意！徵收本地貓片並精心挑選後，電影中心再次帶來港九新界，各品種各姿態的貓主子！沒有最可愛，只有更可愛的貓在戲院恭候著各位貓奴，快點入場向貓主子呈上你的愛意啦！

 

部分收益將捐贈給本地動物慈善機構LAP用予動物救援。
